name: English and Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies Joint Major
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below

sections.title: Lower Division English Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete any two 100-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W, ENGL 114W, ENGL 115W, ENGL 199W

requirements.title: Students also complete any four 200-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 202, ENGL 204, ENGL 209, ENGL 210, ENGL 211, ENGL 213, ENGL 214 and 3 more

sections.note:
Students complete the lower division requirement of the English major program, as follows.
Students wishing to major in English are strongly advised to submit a formal declaration to this effect to the undergraduate advisor upon completing all lower division requirements.

sections.title: Lower Division Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 18 lower division GSWS units
2 of GSWS 100, GSWS 101, GSWS 102
requirements.note: Students complete 18 lower division GSWS units, including two of.

sections.title: Upper Division English Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 20 units of upper division English courses
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of four of these units must be at the 400-level, excluding directed studies courses (ENGL 490, 491); a minimum of four units must be from the following group of courses, focused on Canadian and/or Indigenous Literatures.

requirements.title: 4 units from ENGL 355, ENGL 360, ENGL 431W, ENGL 432W

sections.note: With permission of the department, other English courses of equivalent content may be substituted for those required in this group.

sections.title: Upper Division Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 20 upper division GSWS units

sections.note:
Courses which have high GSWS content may be considered for credit towards this plan.
With the approval of the Department of Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies, students may use as substitution credit one upper division course offered by another department.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
